model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 298 Route 292 in Holmes, New York, as the Sheriff Adrian Butch Anderson Post Office Building.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Michael Lawler (R-NY)

summary.text: The bill would designate a U.S. Postal Service facility in Holmes, New York, as the Sheriff Adrian "Butch" Anderson Post Office Building, honoring the sheriff by naming the building after him.
